## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, B 0→10 T) and hole n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, B 10→0.3 T)

Raw traces first, then `sdh_onset` + the 1/B FFT (`sdh_fft`, degree-5 B-space background) against F_L = (h/4e)|n| and the FS-count model tones (u_D = 0, scale 1). Run 6 is analysed on **B ≥ 1 T only**: its 50 mT steps below 1 T sample a 7 T tone at < 2 pts/period (aliased), so the sub-1 T part carries no tone information.

**Read (preview, not the call):**
- **Both sides show strong SdH at 1.2 K**, SNR 40–140, no rail (max 0.12 of full scale), no leakage (the gate-current excursions are the ~±100 pA settle transients, well under the 1 nA trip).
- **Electron, n = +3.2×10¹² (F_L = 33.1 T):** tones at **≈ 7.3 T** (onset still ≤ 1.0 T: *censored* at the low edge of the usable record) and **≈ 29.4–29.9 T** (0.90·F_L, onset 1.76 T), plus 14.8 / 22.3 T and 37 / 44 / 59 T. `sdh_onset` flags all of them as a harmonic comb of 7.3 T (4 × 7.3 = 29.2), but at a single density that screen is ratio-only. The investigation's Luttinger-aware screen says **don't** discard the 29.4 T tone on the ratio alone: whether 29.4 T is a harmonic or its own pocket is settled by its **n-dependence**. The candidate readings disagree about the pair: the ABAB model gives 7.3 / 25.8 T (partner matches, heavy tone 14 % low); ABCB (qualitative) gives 30.3 / 2.7 T; ABCA gives a single tone at 33.1 T. The observed pair sums to 36.7 T = 1.11·F_L, which sits inside the lever-arm scale band.
- **Hole, n = −1.2×10¹² (F_L = 12.4 T):** a close pair at ≈ 4.4 / 6.7–7.1 T (the model's near-CNP ABAB hole pair is 5.9 / 6.5 T, closer than δF ≈ 1.1 T) and a strong tone at **12.2–12.6 T ≈ F_L** (SNR 122, onset 1.6 T). The model's ABCA hole pocket here has m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ, which is LK-dead at this rig's T_e. So a light tone at F_L is more naturally the **sum orbit** of the pair (breakdown or mixing) than an ABCA pocket. That is a lead for the F_L-tone-origin check, not a verdict.
- **Why the hole side cannot be the design side:** it reaches only |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² inside the validators, which is the investigation's low-|n| exception regime.
- **What the fan must settle:** a fan on the electron side can tell the readings apart by their **slopes**. At a fixed lever-arm scale, the ~29 T tone rises by ≈ 11.6 T (ABAB heavy, 0.70·dF_L/dn) versus ≈ 16.6 T (ABCA) across n = 1.6 → 3.2×10¹². The ~7 T partner either tracks its own Onsager curve (3.1 T per 10¹²) or stays locked at ¼ of the 29 T tone (harmonic). The slope also pins scale and offset separately; the single-density scale (1.11 electron vs ≈ 1.0 hole) hints at an n-offset of ~0.1–0.2×10¹².

"""Runs 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12): sdh-spot-check read. Raw first, then onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L
and the FS-count model tones (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count, u_D = 0). R = (sr1_X/gain)/I_bias, I_bias = 10 nA."""
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")); import fs_count_b0 as M4
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
spots = [(6, +3.2, (1.0, 10.0), 50e-6), (7, -1.2, (1.0, 10.0), 50e-6)]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
for row, (rid, n, (blo, bhi), sens) in enumerate(spots):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / 10e-9
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n) * 1e16)
    ab = [F for F, _ in M4.abab_fs(n * 1e16)[1]]; ca = M4.abca_fs(n * 1e16)[4]
    cb = [F for F, _ in M4.abcb_fs(n * 1e16)[1]] if n > 0 else []
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0; B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T ({len(B)} pts); R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm; "
          f"T {np.nanmax(r.col('T_sample')):.3f} K max; F_L = {FL:.1f} T | model ABAB {[round(f,1) for f in ab]}, ABCA {ca:.1f}, ABCB(qual.) {[round(f,1) for f in cb]}")
    # raw
    ax[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[row, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[row, 0].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[row, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw, n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    # onset on the Nyquist-sampled record (run 6: 50 mT steps below 1 T alias a 7 T tone -> analyse >= 1 T only)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always"); on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=blo, r_full_scale=sens / 10e-9)
    for x in w: print("  warn:", str(x.message)[:160])
    print(on.summary())
    for k, bcut in enumerate([blo, 2.0]):
        fr, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(bcut, bhi), bg_degree=5, log=False); s0 = sp[0] / sp[0].max()
        a = ax[row, 1 + k]; a.plot(fr, s0, lw=1); a.set_xlim(0, 2.4 * FL); a.set_xlabel("F (T)"); a.set_title(f"run {rid} FFT, B in [{bcut}, {bhi}] T")
        a.axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label="F_L")
        for f in ab: a.axvline(f, color="C1", ls=":", lw=1.2)
        a.axvline(ca, color="C2", ls="-.", lw=0.8)
        for f in cb: a.axvline(f, color="C4", ls=":", lw=0.8)
        a.plot([], [], "C1:", label="ABAB model"); a.plot([], [], "C2-.", label="ABCA model"); a.plot([], [], "C4:", label="ABCB (qual.)"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
        p, _ = find_peaks(s0, prominence=0.05); p = p[np.argsort(s0[p])[::-1]][:7]
        print(f"  FFT [{bcut},{bhi}] T: peaks F (rel amp, F/F_L): " + ", ".join(f"{fr[i]:.1f} ({s0[i]:.2f}, {fr[i]/FL:.2f})" for i in p))
fig.suptitle("sdh-spot-check runs 6 (e) / 7 (h) at D = 0 — raw, and 1/B FFT vs F_L + model tones (u_D = 0, scale 1)"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) for the stacking FS count (`tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`)

> **05:28** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: step A n=+3.2e12 B 0.30->0.99 T 261 pts uniform 1/B (sr1 50 uV); step B n 3.2->1.6e12 35 pts x B 1.0->10 T 102 rows uniform 1/B (DINVB 0.9/101), fast 1.8 s, sr1 100 uV; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~09:23** (≈3h55m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show strong SdH on both sides, but no single density can decide the call. On the electron side at +3.2×10¹² there are tones at ≈ 7.3 T and ≈ 29.4 T (0.90·F_L). Their ratio is ≈ 4, so they could be a harmonic comb, an ABAB pair (model 7.3 / 25.8 T), or ABCB/ABCA-like main tones plus something else. The fan settles it through **n-dependence**:
- A harmonic stays locked at k·f.
- Real pockets follow their own Onsager curves. At a fixed scale, the ~29 T tone rises by ≈ 11.6 T (ABAB heavy) versus ≈ 16.6 T (ABCA) across the window.
- The fan also pins the lever-arm **scale and n-offset** separately.

**Side, window, coverage trade.**
- **Electron side:** it is the only side that reaches the investigation's design densities (≳ 2–3×10¹²).
- **Hole side excluded:** the validators cap it at −1.27×10¹², inside the near-CNP exception regime. Run 7 already previews it.
- **n = 3.2 → 1.6×10¹² at D = 0 (run-5 calibration):**
  - The top end is the run-6 point, 16 mV under the TG limit. Sharing that density lets the fan be checked against the spot check (acquisition-quality comparison).
  - A factor of 2 in n gives the slope leverage.
  - Below 1.6 the model's ABAB heavy tone crowds F_L (≥ 0.86) and the partner drops under 2.3 T, unresolvable at this onset. The trade: extending to 1.2 costs +45 min and buys no discriminating column.

**Design numbers (recipe step 1).**
- **B_lo = 1.0 T.** `sdh_onset` on run 6 (B ≥ 1 T; its 50 mT steps below 1 T alias a 7 T tone) gives the 7.3 T tone *censored* at 1.0 T. So 1.0 T is a valid lower bound on the onset.
  - The ~29 T tone's onset is 1.76 T. At m* ≈ 0.06 and T_e ≈ 8 K it is LK-bound, so a lower B_lo buys it nothing.
  - B_lo = 0.8 T would cost ×1.6 (both axes).
  - Step A below pins the true onset for the analysis at almost no cost: it rides the 0 → 1 T ramp the fan needs anyway, ~14 min over a bare ramp.
- **B_hi = 10 T** (session cap). The binding case is the ABAB partner at the low-n end.
- **Sampling:**
  - **B axis:** uniform in 1/B with Δ(1/B) = 0.9/101 T⁻¹, i.e. Nyquist 56 T = 3 pts/period on the fastest observed fundamental (~37 T). **N_B = 102 rows.**
  - **n axis:** Δn = 0.047×10¹² ≤ ½ LL period at B_lo. **N_n = 35.**
  - **Resolution:** δF ≈ 1.1 T for tones alive from 1 T, ≈ 2.1 T for the ~29 T tone. Both are below the 3.7–5 T separations the claim needs.
- **Sensitivity:** fixed at **100 µV (10 kΩ FS)**. The worst corner (n = 1.6, 10 T) is estimated at 1.3–2.1 kΩ (R₀ = 84 Ω × low-n MR/QH), i.e. ≤ 21 % FS. Run 4's lesson: headroom before resolution.
- **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ at 0.3 s / 24 dB (per-column SdH fan). slow_delay 3 s = 10τ after each flyback.
- **Guards:** interrupt on gate leak > 1 nA and on T_sample > 1.7 K, with gates parked.
- **Endpoint:** the fan ends at **10 T** with gates at 0. The next step (LK mass split / firming) rides the field down.

**Price.** Timing calibrated on run 5 (1.10 s/pt at a 1 s dwell) and run 6 (3.1 s/pt at a blocking-magnet step).
- **Step A:** 261 pts × 3.1 s + 0 → 1 T ramp 7.3 min ≈ **22 min**.
- **Step B:** 3570 pts × 1.95 s = 116 min, + 9 T bare traverse 66 min, + 102 rows × ~8.5 s ≈ 14 min, = 196 min. Quoted **≈ 3 h 30 m**, which includes the session's ~7 % overrun margin.
- **Total ≈ 3 h 55 m.**

**Step A → B handoff.** Step B runs as soon as step A completes cleanly: no rail, no leak, oscillations consistent with run 6 above 0.8 T. Step A feeds the analysis (the onset, and a seamless 0.3–10 T uniform-1/B record at n = 3.2 joined with the fan's top column), not the design.

**Checkpoints.**
1. **First 3 fan rows** (~4 min in): R within FS, I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at pA, T at base.
2. **Row ~50** (B ≈ 1.8 T, ~1 h 10 m in): raw ΔR(n, B), with the n = 3.2 column checked against run 6 and step A.
3. **Row ~80** (B ≈ 3.5 T, ~2 h 05 m in): interim per-column FFT over 1–3.5 T to see whether the ~7 T tone tracks its own curve or ¼ of the main tone.

Abort on a rail, leak, or a featureless map.

# === Fan step A — low-field onset extension at the fan's top density (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.30 -> 1.0 T uniform in 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
# --- session calibration, run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration): ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
# Shared 1/B lattice with the fan (step B): 1/B = 0.1 + k*DINVB, DINVB = 0.9/101 T^-1 (Nyquist 56 T = 3 pts/period on the
# fastest observed fundamental, ~37 T in run 6). k = 362..102 -> B 0.3007 -> 0.9912 T (261 pts); the fan continues at k = 101 (1.0 T).
DINVB = 0.9 / 101
B_pre = 1.0 / (0.1 + np.arange(362, 101, -1) * DINVB)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_pre) > 0) and B_pre.max() < 1.01 and B_pre.min() > 0.3
n_top, D0 = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_top, Vbg_top = calc_gate_voltages(n_top, D0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_top <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_top <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_top, Vbg_top)
print(f"spot: n = {n_top:+.2f}e12, D = {D0:+.2f} -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_top:+.4f}, {Vbg_top:+.4f}) V (same point as run 6)")
# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0, _Vsi = T_sample(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_hs, _hv = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05, handoff left 0 T), V_si = {_Vsi:+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {_hs}/{_hv} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(_Vsi) < 0.01 and _hs == 0 and _hv == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled() and k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
print(f"lock-in: tau sr0/sr1 = {sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr0.filter_slope()}/{sr1.filter_slope()} dB (0.3 s / 24 dB), drive {sr1.amplitude()} V")
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24 and sr0.time_constant() == 0.3 and abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-6
# Fixed sensitivity 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA — identical to run 6, so this record differs from run 6 only in its grid
# (uniform-1/B vs uniform-B): the grid-change reproduction check. R(B <= 1 T) <= 60 Ohm at this n (run 6).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 1.7
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = _Vsi; mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"fan step A, low-field onset extension: n = {n_top:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_top:+.4f}, {Vbg_top:+.4f}), "
                  f"B 0.3007 -> 0.9912 T uniform 1/B (DINVB = 0.9/101, shared lattice with the fan), sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'fan step A (onset pin for landau-fan-vti B_lo): electron n = {n_top:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0 V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_top:+.4f}, {Vbg_top:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.3007 -> 0.9912 T, 261 pts uniform in 1/B, DINVB = {DINVB:.6f} 1/T; cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013 V/nm')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_top); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_top)
interruptible_sleep(10)
# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.P); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
def guard(station, data):
    T, i_tg, i_bg = float(data[2]), abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.4f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A"); station.interrupt_requested = True
    if T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.4f} T: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K"); station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(guard, ())
s.sweep(magnet.field, B_pre, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot, field stays at 0.9912 T: the fan (step B) starts here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
### Step B — the fan (runs right after step A completes cleanly; starts at 1.0 T where step A leaves the magnet, ends at 10 T)

# === Fan step B — Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n 3.2 -> 1.6e12 (35 pts) x B 1.0 -> 10.0 T uniform in 1/B (102 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration)
# --- slow axis: shared 1/B lattice with step A, k = 101..0 -> B 1.0 -> 10.0 T ascending (starts where step A left the magnet, ends at 10 T)
DINVB = 0.9 / 101
B_vec = 1.0 / (0.1 + np.arange(101, -1, -1) * DINVB)
assert len(B_vec) == 102 and abs(B_vec[0] - 1.0) < 1e-9 and abs(B_vec[-1] - 10.0) < 1e-9 and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
assert np.abs(B_vec).max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
# --- fast axis: paired (Vtg, Vbg) n-line at D = 0; dn = 0.0471e12 <= 0.048e12 = half the LL period (4e/h)*B at B_lo = 1 T
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.6, 35); Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
_vt, _vb = sanitize_tg_bg(Vtgs, Vbgs, tg_lims, bg_lims)
